title: Replay Codex with stable-options diagnostics

requirement.summary: Install the exact validated Adapter 1.2.2 development source into the existing isolated runtime, preflight its stable-options schema and retry path, and prepare one fresh uncoached Codex replay.

objective.rationale: Static fixtures now classify the second live mismatch, but installed-runtime evidence and a fresh host journey are required before claiming that human direction selection and current-Agent self-review work end to end.

goal: Build and hash the exact current source, update only the existing pipx AgentGov runtime, verify Adapter 1.2.2 and corrected stable-options retry behavior, then reserve the measured journey for a newly created uncoached Codex session.
non_goals: Do not present the local 0.3.0rc1-identified wheel as the immutable published v0.3.0rc1 artifact.
Do not coach the fresh Agent with AgentGov, MCP, alignment, self-review, protocol JSON, or tool names.
Do not add another host, second Agent, independent Reviewer, NYC work, or unrelated product change.
Do not commit, push, publish, release, deploy, or mutate a consumer repository.
acceptance_signals: The exact current source is locally built with official Python 3.12, hash-recorded, and installed only into the existing isolated pipx AgentGov environment.
Installed discovery reports Adapter 1.2.2 and exactly five tools; its no-unknown conditional schema requires two candidates and a non-null recommendation.
One installed foreground process returns stable_options_required, then recommendation_required, then accepts a fully corrected start into ready_for_decision without partial journey state.

A newly created Codex session receives one ordinary multi-direction request without named-tool coaching and either completes human alignment, implementation, validation, and self-review or stops fail-closed with an honest failed result.
No publication, release, deployment, NYC work, consumer mutation, second Agent, or other host occurs.

items: The shared pipx runtime may be locked by existing AgentGov MCP child processes.
The local package identity remains 0.3.0rc1 and must not be confused with the immutable published artifact.
A non-fresh or coached session would invalidate product evidence.

stop_conditions: Stop if installation would touch another project environment, need network access, or mutate a consumer.
Stop unless every locking process is read-only identified as an AgentGov governance-MCP child process before termination.
Stop this active session after installed preflight; only a newly created Codex session is eligible for measured replay.
Stop on any required governance failure before implementation and record the journey honestly.

decision.rationale: Installed Adapter 1.2.2 passed protocol preflight, but the fresh uncoached replay still reached an unclassified Core start rejection and stopped without mutation. The user reviewed the result and explicitly requested a complete Alignment Start contract parity audit on 2026-08-07.
